Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. In proof of having fully adhered to minimum eligibility criteria as mentioned abo ve, attested copy of supply orders issued by the Ministries / Departments under Government of India shall be acceptable. 4. and understanding the entire scope of requirement at 1200 hrs on the day succeeding the publication of bid. 6. The PDF file uploaded should be readable and shall not be password protected. 7. The supplier shall at tend any complaint regarding defective or malfunctioning equipment w ithin 48 hours of receipt of the complaint and ensure rectification withi n a reasonable time. . 11. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period.
